# CostumesPlanet.com

> CostumesPlanet is the ultimate costume guide directory with 195+ detailed blog posts covering costumes for Halloween, cosplay conventions, and themed events. Each guide includes product recommendations with Amazon affiliate links, step-by-step dressing instructions, character background info, and FAQs.

## Site Structure

- **Homepage** (https://costumesplanet.com/) — Browse all 195 costume guides with animated cards, search, and category filters
- **Blog Posts** (https://costumesplanet.com/{slug}) — Individual costume guides with product tables, dressing timelines, FAQ sections, and JSON-LD structured data
- **Categories** (https://costumesplanet.com/categories) — Browse by franchise/genre
- **Category Pages** (https://costumesplanet.com/category/{name}) — Filtered costume listings per category
- **Search** (https://costumesplanet.com/search?q={query}) — Full-text search across all costumes

## Categories

  - Anime (10 costumes)
  - Disney (23 costumes)
  - Game of Thrones (16 costumes)
  - Gaming (31 costumes)
  - Marvel & DC (17 costumes)
  - Pop Culture (80 costumes)
  - Star Wars (4 costumes)
  - Steven Universe (11 costumes)

## Content Per Guide

Each costume guide includes:
1. Hero section with featured image
2. Product table with Amazon affiliate "Buy on Amazon" buttons
3. Step-by-step dressing guide (timeline format)
4. "About the Character" section
5. 7 frequently asked questions with detailed answers
6. Related costume suggestions
7. Full JSON-LD structured data (Article, Product, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList)
